in_sanskrit.name: Mull
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon's Charm
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mull एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mūla' which means 'root' or 'origin'. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is often referred to as 'Chandra Mūla'. This name is believed to bring the charm and grace of the Moon to the bearer.
